stories.title: An unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack, AP source says
stories.summary: An unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack, according to a person familiar with the incident who spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity.

stories.title: The latest College Football Playoff rankings are out and Utah and BYU maintain playoff positioning
stories.summary: In less than four minutes of time, Utah football overwhelmed TCU. And the quick barrage of points likely guaranteed Utah a spot in the College Football Playoff.

stories.title: Cache County School District receives $990K grant to improve student literacy
stories.summary: A Cache Valley school district is getting nearly a million dollars from Intermountain Health to help more students become successful readers.

stories.title: Curtis questions Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: Utah Sen. John Curtis said he agreed with tech CEO Jensen Huang's initial decision to step down from Nvidia and appeared skeptical about Huang's sudden reinstatement this week.

stories.title: U2's new album is about 'defiant joy.' They'll tour it in North America next summer
stories.summary: Fresh off the release of their first album of new songs in nine years, the spirited "Carnaval de Luz," Irish rockers U2 have announced a North American tour.

stories.title: Health officials, food experts give tips for safe food handling as Thanksgiving approaches
stories.summary: Food experts and health officials are reminding the public to take caution when handling food during the holidays.

stories.title: From Black Friday to safety concerns with gifts for kid, Primary Children's expert urges parents to act fast
stories.summary: Parents may not realize some of the biggest safety hazards in their homes and neighborhoods can come in surprisingly small packages.

stories.title: After surviving a stroke, Northern Utah teen gets the elk hunt of a lifetime
Box Elder County sheriff appears in court in automobile homicide case
stories.summary: Box Elder County Sheriff Kevin Potter made his first appearance in court in an automobile homicide case stemming from an Oct. 27 crash in Ogden.

stories.title: Longtime Utah high school sports official Jeff Cluff on life support after stroke
stories.summary: Utah High School Activities Association Associate Director Jeff Cluff, 49, is on life support after suffering a stroke last week.

stories.title: 2 men arrested over suspected burglary at Prince William and Kate's country home
stories.summary: Two men were arrested on the British royal family's Sandringham estate, police said Tuesday, after a reported break-in at the country home of Prince William and Princess Catherine.

stories.title: Raise the Future brings adoptive families together at Boondocks
stories.summary: For 25 years, Raise the Future has brought adoptive and guardianship families together for a day of fun and connection.
